prose: A Bloomberg report indexed by Techmeme says Suno introduced a video feature that generates short clips and can combine them into music videos using a MiniMax-based model. The excerpt says video credits cost extra. The full source was inaccessible, so plan eligibility, exact pricing, rights and output limits were not checked.
highlights: Excerpt describes a new music-video feature
Short clips can reportedly be combined
Model attribution comes from the report
Video credits are described as an extra cost
Exact terms and rights remain unverified
